info.name: Kitameraki - Task Management API
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint of the Task Management API (Express + Azure Cosmos DB + Azure Blob Storage).

Run the whole collection with the Postman Collection Runner (or `npx newman run "postman/Kitameraki - Task Management API.postman_collection.json" --working-dir postman`) — requests are ordered so variables such as `task_id` and `file_id` are captured automatically. "Upload File" sends `sample-attachment.txt` from the collection folder (set Postman's working directory to `backend/postman`, or re-select the file).

Swagger UI: {{app_url}}/api/docs

request.description: Saves the whole form (schemaVersion 3, bpmn.io form-js components): template fields (renamed Title, extra 'In Review' status option), custom components, a conditionally hidden Impact field, a group with a path (`client`), a dynamic list (`checklist`), a file picker, an expression and the Submit / Reset buttons. Max 2 components per row; groups and dynamic lists hold rows of their own.
